changelog:
Initial release of cls-news-scraper.

- Pulls real-time market news from Cailian Press (CLS).
- Extracts and classifies stock-positive catalysts based on event and sector filters.
- Outputs structured data: ticker, company, catalyst, source URL, timestamp, and confidence.
- Designed for easy filtering and downstream scoring.
summary: Extract real-time stock-positive market news from Cailian Press filtered by time, sector, and event type for catalyst identification.
